name: SnowPro Core Certification

fee.note: USD 175 per attempt; Snowflake charges USD 140 to candidates testing in India. Retakes cost the full fee, with no free retakes or retake discounts.

exam.format: 100 multiple-choice and multiple-select questions (unscored items may be included), 115 minutes, online proctored or at a test center, in English, Japanese, Korean, French or Spanish.

scope: The Snowflake AI Data Cloud: architecture, accounts and virtual warehouses, data loading and unloading, structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, performance optimization, governance, data protection and data collaboration.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: COF-C03 is the only SnowPro Core version Snowflake lists (read 2026-11-17); it replaced COF-C02 in 2026, and Snowflake's pages no longer give the transition dates. Prep material written for COF-C02 may not match the C03 domains.
After a failed attempt you wait seven days to retake, and you can take the same exam at most four times in 12 months.

Certifications expire two years after they are awarded. They renew through Snowflake's Continuing Education program (passing an eligible SnowPro exam or completing eligible instructor-led training) or by retaking the full exam within six months before expiry.
The study guide is a PDF behind a short form on the certification page.
